parsed.name: LibUSB USB通信库
parsed.description: LibUSB 是一个开源、跨平台的用户态 USB 通信库，用于让上层应用直接访问和控制 USB 设备，常用于实验仪器通信与数据传输。
parsed.description_en: libusb is an open-source, cross-platform user-space USB communication library that lets applications access and control USB devices, commonly used for instrument communication and data transfer.
